title: VendPoint Substitute Placements: Ordered Supply to the Ship-To
content:
When the substitute Corbett places in a retired item's selection on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine also reaches the machine's ship-to on order lines of its Ship-To Fulfillment Account, the par is sized at an order share.

**Rule.** The order channel factor follows the units of the substitute shipped on order lines to the machine's ship-to in the three months ending today: when those units are above zero and at least the retired item's units, the factor is the heavy order share; when they are above zero and below the retired item's units, the factor is the light order share; otherwise the factor is one.

**Figures.** The heavy order share is 0.75; the light order share is 0.9.

**What are the retired item's units?** The retired item's units are its units vended from the machine in the three months ending today, less its units returned to the machine or credited for a vend error in the same three months, each record counted by its date.

**How are the three months counted?** Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

| Substitute units shipped to the ship-to, three months | Compared with the retired item's units | Order channel factor |
|---|---|---|
| Above zero | At least | 0.75 |
| Above zero | Below | 0.9 |
| Zero | not applicable | 1 |

Hypothetical: with 30 retired item units, 30 substitute units shipped give 0.75, 12 give 0.9, none give 1.
